blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skill memories encode past experiences as textual prompts to improve reinforcement learning (RL) for self-evolving agents. Complementing RL, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) provides dense, fine-grained supervision to internalize knowledge from skill-guided trajectories and accelerate policy learning. However, self-generated memories often contain noisy supervision and functionally entangled, redundant, or conflicting knowledge, making direct distillation difficult. Under limited training budgets, these issues can hinder knowledge internalization and even degrade performance. To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization. MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches. OPSD then transfers and consolidates complementary experiential knowledge across these branches into a shared policy, enabling efficient skill internalization and continuous agent self-evolution. We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models. Without additional computational overhead, MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop. Extensive ablations and evolution analyses further validate its effectiveness in knowledge internalization and policy improvement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDSKILL-CF53.
blocks.zh: 技能记忆将过去的经验编码为文字提示,用于改进自我进化剂的强化学习(RL). 补充RL,On-Political Self-dispiration(OPSD)提供密集的,精细的监管,从技能指导的轨迹将知识内化,加速政策学习. 然而,自我生成的记忆中往往包含吵闹的监管和功能缠绕,冗余,或相互冲突的知识,使得直接蒸馏变得困难. 在有限的培训预算下,这些问题可能妨碍知识内部化,甚至降低业绩。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出MDSKILLL,一种技能内存内化的多视角蒸馏方法. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated strong performance on multi-turn interactive tasks ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . However, sparse and delayed rewards provide limited supervision for policy improvement. Skill memories offer a promising source of experiential knowledge: they summarize lessons from real interaction trajectories and guide subsequent decisions through textual prompts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Although external skill memories improve task success, agent self-evolution requires internalizing their experiential knowledge into model parameters to retain and apply acquired capabilities without explicit memory retrieval. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) distills skill-view trajectories into the skill-free branch, providing dense supervision for skill internalization and policy learning ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Combining OPSD with RL enables more effective agent self-evolution and greater performance gains ( Lu et al., 2026a ; Tu et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 代理强化学习(RL)在多回合互动任务上表现出强效表现(Shao等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年;Dong等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年). 然而,对政策改进的监督有限,奖励很少和拖延。 技能记忆提供了一个很有希望的经验性知识来源:它们总结了从真实互动轨迹中吸取的教训,并通过文字提示指导随后的决定(Shinn等人,2023年;Wang等人,2023年). 虽然外部技能记忆改善了任务的成功,但代理人自我进化需要将其经验性知识内部化为模型参数,以便在没有明确内存检索的情况下保留和应用获得的能力. On-Political Self-Distriction(OPSD)将技能视角轨迹提炼成无技能分支,为技能内在化和政策学习提供密集的监督(Zhao等人,2026年;He等人,2026年a; 张等, 2026a.). 将OPSD与RL结合,可以实现更有效的代理自我演化和更大的性能收益(Lu等人,2026a;Tu等人,2026a).

blocks.en: OPSD uses high-quality reference responses to provide reliable teacher supervision ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . In online agent self-evolution, however, the teacher branch relies on self-generated skill memories that may contain ineffective, harmful, or hallucinated strategies, potentially causing the skill-view branch to underperform its skill-free counterpart ( Tu et al., 2026a ) . Our observational experiments further suggest that jointly applying skills with different decision functions entangles their roles, while redundancy and conflicts obscure their individual contributions. Consequently, direct distillation can propagate erroneous behaviors and provide inconsistent supervision for useful knowledge, hindering its internalization into model parameters.
blocks.zh: OPSD使用高质量的参考响应来提供可靠的教师监督(Zhao等人,2026年). 然而,在网络代理自我进化中,教师分支依赖于可能包含无效、有害或幻觉策略的自生技能记忆,可能导致技能视角分支的无技能对应性表现不佳(Tu等人,2026a)。 我们的观察实验进一步表明,联合应用具有不同决策功能的技能会缠绕他们的角色,而冗余和冲突会掩盖他们个人的贡献。 因此,直接蒸馏可以传播错误的行为,为有用的知识提供不一致的监督,阻碍其内部化成为模型参数.

blocks.en: Motivated by these observations, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation framework for skill memory internalization. It uses dynamic value metrics to select skills with additional decision value and organizes them into three complementary functional views: state grounding, action planning, and execution control. These views guide three view-specific branches and an integrated branch alongside a skill-free branch. By disentangling experience according to its decision function, multi-view distillation reduces transfer interference and consolidates complementary knowledge into the shared policy. The skill-view and skill-free branches then co-evolve, generating better trajectories and skill memories that sustain agent self-evolution. Figure 1 summarizes MDSKILL’s framework, empirical results, and the intuition behind multi-view distillation.
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们提出MDSKILL,一个技能内存内化的多视角蒸馏框架. 它使用动态值度量法来选择具有额外决策值的技能,并将其组织成三个互补功能视图:状态地基,行动规划和执行控制. 这些观点指导着三个专有视野的分支和一个与无技能分支并列的分支. 通过根据其决策功能疏解经验,多视角分解可以减少转移干扰,并将互补知识整合到共享政策中. 技能观和无技能分支随后共同演化,产生更好的轨迹和技能记忆,维持代理人自我演化. 图1总结了MDSKILL的框架、经验结果和多视角蒸馏背后的直觉。

blocks.en: Across three agent benchmarks, MDSKILL outperforms RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models, improving upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop without additional computational overhead. Extensive ablations and skill-evolution analyses support its effectiveness, while gains in both skill-view and skill-free branches indicate successful knowledge internalization rather than continued reliance on external memories. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We observe and identify a key challenge in skill-guided agent self-evolution: noisy and functionally entangled skill memories can hinder knowledge internalization and degrade performance. • We propose MDSkill, a multi-view distillation framework that organizes skill memories into complementary decision views and transfers knowledge across skill-view and skill-free branches for more stable and effective experiential knowledge internalization. • Experiments on three agent benchmarks show that MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance, with extensive ablations and skill-evolution analyses supporting its effectiveness.

blocks.en: 3 Analysis of Distillation Directions
blocks.zh: 3 稀释方向分析

blocks.en: We analyze four training variants to examine how distillation direction affects skill-memory internalization: no distillation, forward distillation from the skill-view to the skill-free branch, reverse distillation in the opposite direction, and bidirectional distillation combining both.
blocks.zh: 我们分析四种训练变体,以研究蒸馏方向如何影响技能-记忆内化:不蒸馏,从技能视角向无技能分支的前蒸馏,逆向蒸馏,双向蒸馏结合两者.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , all distillation variants outperform no distillation on both branches, demonstrating that distillation effectively converts knowledge externalized in skill memories into the policy’s intrinsic capabilities.

blocks.en: Forward-only distillation performs substantially worse because the dense supervision signals from the skill-view branch are unreliable. Since both branches share the same policy, this unreliable token-level supervision degrades both skill-view and skill-free behavior.

blocks.en: Reverse-only distillation achieves the strongest performance on both branches, surpassing even bidirectional distillation. This result highlights distillation’s sensitivity to supervision quality: dense but unreliable signals from forward distillation can dilute or counteract the gains from reverse correction. The advantage of reverse-only distillation thus lies in removing unstable forward supervision, allowing externalized skill knowledge to enter policy parameters indirectly through RL while reverse distillation corrects unreliable skill-guided behavior.
blocks.zh: 只反向蒸馏在两分支上都取得了最强的性能,甚至超过了双向蒸馏. 这一结果突出了蒸馏对监督质量的敏感性:来自前蒸馏的密集但不可靠的信号可以稀释或抵消反向修正的收益. 因此,只反向蒸馏的优点在于去除不稳定的前导,允许外部化的技能知识通过RL间接进入政策参数,而反向蒸馏则纠正了不可靠的技能引导行为.

blocks.en: To investigate why forward distillation degrades performance, we follow ( Li et al., 2026b ) and analyze Top- K K overlap and the absolute entropy gap in Figure 3 . Forward distillation requires the skill-free branch to reproduce skill-conditioned preferences without access to the underlying skill. Its low, volatile overlap and large, fluctuating entropy gap suggest persistent misalignment and unstable supervision, potentially introducing noisy policy updates. In contrast, reverse distillation primarily corrects harmful skill influence and exhibits increasing overlap and a smaller, more stable entropy gap.
blocks.zh: 为了调查前向蒸馏降解性能的原因,我们跟踪(Li等人,2026b),并分析图3中的Top-K K重叠和绝对 en空. 前进蒸馏需要没有技能的分支复制技能条件化的偏好,而无法获得基础技能. 其低、多变的重叠和大、多变的肽类差距表明持续存在的错位和不稳定的监管,有可能引入吵闹的政策更新。 相比之下,反向蒸馏主要纠正了有害技能的影响,并显示出日益重叠和较小的,更稳定的 en间隙.

blocks.en: Although forward distillation underperforms reverse distillation, it substantially outperforms no distillation, indicating that skill-guided supervision contains useful knowledge alongside unreliable signals. The challenge therefore lies not simply in a lack of valuable knowledge, but in transferring it effectively. Beyond skill noise, redundant or conflicting guidance from entangled decision functions can obscure useful signals and complicate internalization. These observations motivate dynamic value metrics to prioritize reliable, beneficial skills and multi-view decomposition to separate complementary decision functions, improving supervision quality and reducing transfer interference.
blocks.zh: 虽然前向蒸馏表现不佳,反向蒸馏却大大超过不蒸馏,表明技术指导的监督与不可靠的信号一起包含有用的知识. 因此,挑战不仅仅是缺乏宝贵的知识,而是有效转让知识。 除了技能噪声之外,来自缠绕决策功能的冗余或相互冲突的指导可能模糊有用的信号,并使内部化复杂化. 这些观察激励了动态价值衡量标准,将可靠,有益的技能和多视图分解作为优先事项,以分离互补决策功能,提高监督质量,减少转移干扰.

blocks.en: 4 MDSKILL
blocks.zh: 4MDSKIL (英语).

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: MDSkill is a self-evolution framework that builds on OPSD to aggregate and internalize knowledge from skill memories. It combines dynamic skill selection with multi-view exploration and distillation to internalize complementary knowledge into the shared policy. The improved policy generates better trajectories and higher-quality skill memories, which strengthen policy learning, forming a closed loop of skill evolution, knowledge internalization, and agent self-evolution.
blocks.zh: MDSkill是一个基于OPSD的自我进化框架,从技能记忆中集聚和内化知识. 它将动态技能选择与多视角探索和提炼相结合,将互补知识内化为共享政策. 改进后的政策产生了更好的轨迹和更高的技能记忆,加强了政策学习,形成了技能进化,知识内化,代理自我进化的密闭循环.

blocks.en: 4.2 Dynamic Skill Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 动态技能计量

blocks.en: Skill value estimation identifies useful memories and filters harmful ones, but their value changes as the policy evolves: previously useful skills may become redundant through internalization or be superseded by better strategies. MDSKILL therefore maintains two dynamic, policy-relative estimates, Reliability and Advantage , updated with new interaction outcomes throughout training. Temporal decay gives recent evidence greater weight, preventing historical performance from dominating the assessment of a skill’s current value.
blocks.zh: 技能价值估计确定有用的记忆并过滤有害的记忆,但其价值随着政策的发展而变化:以前有用的技能可能通过内化而变得多余,或者被更好的战略所取代. 因此,MDSKILL维持两个动态的、与政策有关的估计,即可靠性和优势,并在整个培训过程中更新新的互动结果。 时间衰减使得最近的证据更加重要,使历史表现无法主导对技能当前价值的评估。

blocks.en: 4.3 Multi-View Skill Rollouts
blocks.zh: 4.3 多维技能推广

blocks.en: High-value experience can support different aspects of a decision. MDSkill organizes skill memory around three complementary functions—state grounding, action planning, and execution control—and uses these views to guide exploration and selective knowledge transfer into a shared policy.
blocks.zh: 高价值的经验可以支持决定的不同方面。 MDSkill将技能记忆围绕三个互补功能——状态定位、行动规划和执行控制——组织起来,并利用这些观点指导探索和有选择的知识转让成为共同政策。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Functional Skill Views
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 职能技能意见

blocks.en: We generate skills through view-specific reflection prompts, each directing the agent to extract a distinct type of reusable knowledge from its interaction experience. The prompts are adapted to each environment, and the resulting skills are maintained in three functional pools, ℳ g \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{g}} , ℳ p \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{p}} , ℳ c \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{c}} .
blocks.zh: 我们通过特定视图的反射提示来产生技能,每个提示都指示代理人从其互动经验中提取出一种独特的可重复使用的知识. 提示会适应每个环境,所产生的技能会维持在三个功能池中,Mg\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{g}}},M\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{p}}},Mc\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{c}}}.

blocks.en: This view addresses what is known about the current situation . Grounding skills identify task-relevant observations, object states, constraints, and missing information. They guide the agent to inspect its environment, resolve uncertainty, and distinguish verified facts from assumptions before committing to an action. Exploration under this view emphasizes obtaining and interpreting evidence that makes subsequent decisions better informed.
blocks.zh: 这种观点涉及目前的情况。 基础技能确定与任务有关的观察、对象状态、制约因素和缺失的信息。 它们指导代理人检查其环境,解决不确定性,并在采取行动之前将核实的事实与假设区分开来。 根据这一观点进行的勘探强调获取和解释证据,使随后的决定更加知情。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Following the evaluation suite of SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , we evaluate on three agent benchmarks. ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) tests household navigation and object manipulation across six task families: Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, and Pick2. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) requires agents to find and purchase products satisfying natural-language requests; we use the established 128-task evaluation split. Search-QA ( Jin et al., 2025 ) evaluates search-augmented question answering across three single-hop and four multi-hop datasets. We report success rates on ALFWorld, task scores and success rates on WebShop, and answer accuracy on Search-QA.
blocks.zh: 继SDAR(Lu等人,2026a)的评价套件之后,我们按三个代理基准进行评估。 ALFWorld(Shridhar等人,2020年)测试了家庭导航和物体操纵,跨越了六个任务家庭:Pick,Look,Clean,Heat,Cool,和Pick2. WebShop(Yao等人,2022年)要求代理商寻找和购买满足自然语言请求的产品;我们使用既定的128任务评价拆分. Search-QA(Jin等人,2025年)评价了3个单跳和4个多跳数据集的搜索解答问题. 我们报告ALFWorld的成功率,任务分数和WebShop的成功率,以及Search-QA的答案准确性.

blocks.en: We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3-1.7B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as backbones. We compare against three baseline groups: (1) skill-free RL methods, GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2026 ) ; (2) skill-augmented methods, SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , D2Skill ( Tu et al., 2026b ) , SkillC ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , SAPO ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , and Skill1 ( Shi et al., 2026 ) ; and (3) self-distillation methods, OPSD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , RLSD ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , Skill-SD ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , StepOPSD ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) and UCOB ( Tu et al., 2026a ) . These baselines provide broad coverage of agent self-evolution methods. For fair comparison, MDSKILL follows the same experimental settings as the corresponding baselines; details are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that MDSkill achieves the best overall success rates on both ALFWorld and WebShop across all three backbones. On ALFWorld, MDSkill outperforms the strongest baseline UCOB by 7.1%, 3.1%, and 2.3% with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Qwen2.5-7B, respectively. On WebShop, it improves the success rate by 8.1%, 3.2%, and 3.9%, while maintaining competitive task scores. MDSKILL also achieves competitive performance on Search-QA across model scales. Compared with interactive decision-making tasks, Search-QA depends more on retrieval quality, evidence comprehension, and answer synthesis, and less on recurring environment states where reusable skills offer consistent guidance.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,MDSkill在ALFWorld和WebShop三个骨干部门都取得了最佳的总体成功率。 在ALFWorld上,MDSkill分别以7.1%,3.1%和2.3%的优于最强基线UCOB,分别以Qune3–1.7B,Qune2.5–3B和Qune2.5–7B. 在WebShop上,它提高了8.1%,3.2%和3.9%的成功率,同时保持了竞争性的任务分数. MDSKILL还在Search-QA上实现了跨模型尺度的竞争性性能. 与互动决策任务相比,Search-QA更多地依赖于检索质量、证据理解和回答综合,而较少依赖于重复使用的技能提供一致指导的经常性环境状态。

blocks.en: The consistent gains on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate the value of internalizing skill memories from complementary decision perspectives. The gains are particularly pronounced with the smaller Qwen3-1.7B model which has fewer task-relevant priors and reusable interaction patterns, with success rates increasing from 86.7% to 93.8% on ALFWorld and from 74.7% to 82.8% on WebShop. By organizing skill memories into complementary views and distilling successful behaviors into the shared policy, MDSkill mitigates the knowledge disadvantage of smaller models, while the improved policy produces stronger trajectories and higher-quality skills that further reinforce knowledge internalization and agent self-evolution.
blocks.zh: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得的持续进展表明,从互补的决策角度将技能记忆内部化很有价值。 在较小的Qwen3-1.7B模式中,收益尤其显著,该模式与任务相关的前科和可重复使用的互动模式较少,成功率从ALFWorld的86.7%增至93.8%,从WebShop的74.7%增至82.8%。 通过将技能记忆组织成互补观点,并将成功的行为提炼成共享政策,MDSkill减轻了较小模型的知识劣势,而改进后的政策则产生更强的轨迹和更高的技能,进一步强化知识内在化,促进自我进化.

blocks.en: Figure 6(a) compares success rates and skill-view advantage, defined as the success-rate difference between skill-view and skill-free branches; a sustained negative gap indicates that memories hinder the evolving policy. We ablate forward distillation, cross-view distillation, multi-view rollouts, and distillation. MDSKILL performs best on both benchmarks, with its advantage approaching zero without remaining strongly negative. Removing distillation causes the greatest degradation, while removing multi-view rollouts has the largest impact among variants retaining distillation. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We identify a key obstacle to skill-guided agent self-evolution: noisy and functionally entangled skill memories can provide unstable supervision, hindering knowledge internalization. We propose MDSKILL, a multi-view framework that dynamically selects useful skills, organizes them into complementary functional views, and explores both view-specific and integrated solutions. Outcome-based teacher–student grouping then supports forward, reverse, and cross-view distillation, enabling complementary knowledge to be reliably consolidated into the shared policy. Experiments on three agent benchmarks demonstrate SOTA performance, while ablations and evolution analyses verify more stable distillation and healthier skill evolution. Overall, MDSKILL establishes a self-evolution cycle in which multi-view skill knowledge improves the policy, and the evolving policy continually generates and internalizes better skill memories.
blocks.zh: 我们发现技能指导代理人自我进化的主要障碍:吵闹和功能缠绕的技能记忆可以提供不稳定的监督,阻碍知识内部化. 我们提议MDSKILL是一个多视图框架,它能动态地选择有用的技能,将它们组织成互补的功能性观点,并探索特定视图和综合解决方案. 基于结果的教师-学生组合随后支持前向、反向和交叉视角的提炼,使互补知识能够可靠地整合到共同政策中。 关于三种剂基准的实验显示了SOTA的性能,而模拟和演化分析则验证出更稳定的蒸馏和更健康的技能演化. 总的来说,MDSKILL建立了自演循环,其中多视角技能知识可以改善政策,不断演变的政策不断产生和内化更好的技能记忆.

blocks.en: A.1 Skill Memories for Language Agents
blocks.zh: A.1 语言代理人技能记忆

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation established a general paradigm for conditioning language models on external, non-parametric knowledge ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) . Language agents extend this paradigm from factual documents to interaction experience: Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) stores verbal feedback from previous attempts, while Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) accumulates executable programs as reusable skills. Recent work further enables agents to construct, select, curate, evolve, or internalize their own skill memories ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Mi et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026b ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026a ) . These methods progress from retrieval-time skill augmentation toward evolving external repositories and policy-level knowledge internalization. However, self-generated skills may be noisy, redundant, or functionally entangled; MDSKILL addresses these limitations through dynamic skill selection and multi-view distillation.

blocks.en: A.2 Agentic Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: A.2 代理强化学习

blocks.en:
Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) stabilizes policy learning through clipped updates, while
GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) replaces the learned value
function with relative rewards among grouped rollouts. Building
on these foundations, recent agentic RL methods extend policy
optimization to multi-turn environments involving reasoning,
search, tool use, and environment interaction ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
These methods enable agents to improve from interaction outcomes,
but their supervision remains largely dependent on sparse and
delayed rewards. MDSKILL adopts GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2026 ) as its RL backbone because its combination of episode- and step-level optimization is well suited to long-horizon, multi-turn agent interactions.

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision

mismatch ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . On-Policy Self-Distillation
(OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) further uses the same policy as teacher and

supervision alongside sparse RL rewards without requiring a

Recent work combines OPSD with agentic RL through skill-conditioned contexts, adaptive supervision, step-level transfer, and bidirectional correction ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Tu et al., 2026a ) . However, its effectiveness depends on the reliability of retrieved skills. MDSKILL addresses this issue by decomposing skill knowledge into complementary views and performing outcome-guided multi-view distillation.

blocks.en: Across all three benchmarks, we train MDSKILL for 150 steps with a rollout group size of 8, a training batch size of 16, and a validation batch size of 128. Each rollout group contains four skill-free trajectories and one skill-guided trajectory for each grounding, planning, control, and combined branch, resulting in a 4 : 1 : 1 : 1 : 1 4{:}1{:}1{:}1{:}1 allocation. Its maximum search horizon and retained interaction history are both 4 turns. All experiments use eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The code is available at the https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDSKILL-CF53 .

blocks.en: B.3 Retrieval.

blocks.en: We organize skill memories into three functional banks corresponding to state grounding, action planning, and execution control. At each encountered anchor state, we first retrieve the 10 most relevant candidates from each bank using the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence transformer, with a relevance threshold of 0.4. For each candidate, we independently draw Thompson samples from its Reliability and Advantage posteriors and rank candidates by their equally weighted sum. Each view-specific branch selects the top three skills from its corresponding bank, whereas the combined branch selects the highest-ranked skill from each bank. Both posteriors are initialized with uniform Beta ⁡ ( 1 , 1 ) \operatorname{Beta}(1,1) priors and use a temporal-decay half-life of 20 training steps. Within each functional bank, we further distinguish task-level and state-level memories following UCOB ( Tu et al., 2026a ) .

This scale-dependent reversal suggests that the gate reflects the
reliability required of skill-view supervision. Smaller models possess
less task knowledge and tend to generate lower-quality skills, making
skill-view trajectories more likely to provide misleading supervision.
The strict gate permits forward and cross-view distillation only when
all skill-free trajectories fail, filtering ambiguous comparisons
and providing stronger evidence of skill-induced knowledge gain. Larger models generate and utilize more reliable skills; consequently, the relaxed gate can admit more informative teacher–student pairs and enlarge the effective distillation space without introducing excessive noise. Thus, strict filtering is preferable when skill-view supervision is less reliable, whereas relaxed filtering better exploits the stronger
supervision available at larger model scales.

blocks.en: We provide a local perspective on why multi-view skill decomposition can stabilize distillation. A successful mixed-skill trajectory may draw simultaneously on grounding, planning, and control knowledge, making it difficult to identify which guidance produced useful behavior. Redundant or conflicting guidance may also induce inconsistent token-level gradients. In a view-specific trajectory, the added skill guidance has an explicit functional role. This makes the supervision source easier to interpret, although success alone does not establish that the skill caused the outcome.
